1.name: House of Leaves Wallpaper
1.desc: I wanted a wallpaper of the cover of house of leaves, but I couldn't find any decent scans, so I decided to remake it myself.

2.name: Breaking off the rust
2.desc: This is the first full illustration I did since attempting to get back into drawing. It's pretty rough, given both my rustiness and my lack of experience working with a tablet (most of my drawing was on paper with pencil/pen). I'm still happy I was able to finish it though, however rough it may be.

3.name: Chibi Draco Centauros
3.desc: When I worked as a camp counsellor, I used to doodle a lot of chibi dracos like this while on bathroom watch. Sometimes I think its the only thing that got me through that job.

4.name: Classic Sonic w/ New Setup
4.desc: I was going for Toei sonic, but old archie bled in too. First time w/ new tablet setup, my awesome GF attached a sketch book page to the top to give the tablet grain. It was a huge improvement for me.

5.name: Old Art #1: Cubism Frog
5.desc: This was a cubist piece I did in highschool. I remember having a pretty tough time getting the blending right around the frog's face

6.name: Old Art #2: Two-Point Perspective City
6.desc: I've always been quite fond of perspective pieces, and I'm quite proud of the shading on this one. Excuse my horrible handwriting though lol.

7.name: Old Art #3: Covid Era Album Cover
7.desc: Homestuck vol.5 x Animal Crossing. This is probably the most covid image I have.

8.name: Old Art #4: Covid Era Homestuck Crossover
8.desc: Homestuck x Naruto, this one may actually be more covid than the last.

9.name: Old Art #5: Mystery Girl (Still Covid Era)
9.desc: A mystery girl I sketched at some point. I don't know what her deal is but she has spunk

10.name: Old Art #6: Kanaya (Covid) Maryam
10.desc: A fairly decent Kanaya. Shes always been my favorite troll, which in retrospect may have been a sign 🏳️‍⚧️
